description: Versions are pinned exactly, so every upgrade arrives as a reviewable PR
rather than resolving silently on install. Renovate updates pnpm catalog
entries in pnpm-workspace.yaml directly, which is why it is preferred here.

packageRules.description: Peer ranges are deliberately wide so consumers can bring their own version.
vanilla-extract packages must move together. A css bump without a matching vite-plugin bump can resolve two copies, and its file-scope keying breaks the build when that happens.
Router and its Vite plugin are version-coupled.
React runtime and its types should not drift apart.
Longer cooldown on major bumps, which are the ones most likely to be yanked or hotfixed.
Tooling that only affects local development can move in one batch.
